pins.name: Ammo constructor initializes field130 from default
replacement constructs exactlyone native new item

finding: The current own-role generator omits BrokenItemClassId. Native Ammo initializes its BrokenGUID field to zero; the break branch removes the original and attempts native creation from that GUID without a GUID-validity branch.
limits: File-byte proof, not execution of the XML loader, contact, damage or inventory save.
Native material/contact outcome decides whether the break branch is taken; not every impact necessarily takes it.
No unbreakable, guaranteed embedding, recoverable item or duplicate-free self-reference policy is established.
No blind self-referencing BrokenGUID or bypass of native contact/RPG logic is proposed.
